title: 摩根士丹利邢自强：K型经济难改，消费外溢有限
speaker: Robin Xing

segments.en: It will continue to march on, expanding from advanced tech, growing energy to a lot of other sectors, including capital goods.
segments.zh: 它将继续前进，从先进技术、能源扩展到许多其他行业，包括资本品。

segments.en: But, as I mentioned, that top half of the K is structurally too saying to have spill over to jobs, to income, to consumer expectation.
segments.zh: 但正如我所说，K型上半部分结构上太强，无法溢出到就业、收入和消费预期。

segments.en: So, unfortunately, even if China can reach the annual GDP target, that case-ship economy is probably here to stay.
segments.zh: 所以不幸的是，即使中国能达到年度GDP目标，这种K型经济可能还会持续。

segments.en: We talk about this kind of structural shift that needs to happen with policy, but Robin, isn't this a really big picture, longer-term shift, right?
segments.zh: 我们谈到这种需要政策推动的结构性转变，但这不是一个更宏大、更长期的转变吗？

segments.en: The government has been wanting to turn to domestic consumption for the last 10 years, 20 years, and it hasn't quite sort of happened to the strength that you might expect.
segments.zh: 过去10年、20年，政府一直想转向国内消费，但并未达到预期的力度。

segments.en: Is it possible, do you think, with major changes to social welfare, with major changes to what we've seen with the property sector, for example, to be able to turn around the demographic issues?
segments.zh: 你认为，通过社会福利和房地产领域的重大变革，能否扭转人口问题？

segments.en: Well, I do think you need the understanding of the roadblocks. The roadblocks for consumers are a compilation of housing.
segments.zh: 我认为需要理解障碍。消费者的障碍是住房问题的集合。

segments.en: The housing sector is still in decline. In fact, housing investment as percentage of total economy declined from the peak level of 16% to 6%.
segments.zh: 房地产行业仍在下降。事实上，住房投资占经济总量的比例从16%的峰值下降到6%。
